I joined the Byrnes lab as a Masters student and am now purusing a PhD working on marine urban ecological interactions within the Boston Harbor. My research focuses on the effects of eco-engineering interventions within the intertidal and how they can influence biodiversity and community structure. I am working with the Living Seawalls project conducting biological surveys of two installations within Boston this summer 2024.
